description.raw: '''Toggle:''' '''Amumu''' cries a continuous pool of tears, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies.
description.text: Toggle: Amumu cries a continuous pool of tears, dealing magic damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies.

description2.raw: ''Despair'' is toggled off automatically if '''Amumu''' becomes unable to pay its [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost.
description2.text: Despair is toggled off automatically if Amumu becomes unable to pay its  mana cost.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage Per Tick:'''
5 (+ 0.5 / 0.625 / 0.75 / 0.875 / 1% (+ 0.25% per 100 AP) of target's '''maximum''' health)
leveling.text: Magic Damage Per Tick:5 (+ 0.5 / 0.625 / 0.75 / 0.875 / 1% (+ 0.25% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

notes.raw: * Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * Despite the rounding in ''Despair's'' tooltip, it will deal increased damage for every point of ability power.
notes.text:
Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Despite the rounding in Despair's tooltip, it will deal increased damage for every point of ability power.
